name: claude-talk-to-figma-mcp
description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) plugin that allows Claude Desktop and other AI tools to interact directly with Figma, enabling powerful AI-assisted design capabilities.

figma_tool_profile.title: Tool profile
figma_tool_profile.description: How many tools to advertise to the model. The tool list is re-sent on every request, so a smaller profile costs fewer tokens per message and leaves more context for the design. 'core' (~48 tools) covers layout, text, colour, variables and the responsive workflow. 'standard' (~87 tools, default) adds everything except FigJam, REST comments and activity tracking. 'full' advertises all 115. Nothing is ever lost: a withheld tool is still callable through figma_batch.

figma_access_token.title: Figma personal access token
figma_access_token.description: Optional. Only needed for the comment tools (read and reply to Figma comments), which use Figma's REST API because the plugin sandbox cannot access comments. Create one at Figma → Account settings → Security → Personal access tokens, with the scopes 'files:read' and 'file_comments:write'. Every other tool works without it.

figma_api_concurrency.title: Comment sweep concurrency
figma_api_concurrency.description: How many Figma files to read in parallel when sweeping a team or project for comments. Lower this if you hit rate limits.

figma_max_response_chars.title: Maximum tool response size (characters)
figma_max_response_chars.description: Hard ceiling on how much text one tool call may return. Oversized results are truncated with a note telling the model to narrow the query, so a single deep node read cannot flood the context window. ~24000 characters is roughly 6000 tokens.
